entries.zh: 配；相配成对，如已婚夫妇之匹配；婚配
entries.en: to match, pair, like a married couple; wedded, well-matched

entries.zh: 及人；推己及人，以同等的良心待人（西注“同等的良心”）
entries.en: to extend oneself to others equally (in conscience); equal conscience
entries.notes: L 栏 igual conciencia 与汉字“及人”的对应须经“推己及人”推断；R 栏空

entries.zh: 同；相同，同等齐一
entries.en: same, equal; paired, of one order

entries.zh: 裁；裁剪使齐，裁齐匀等；裁断
entries.en: to cut or trim even; to equalize; to cut, judge
entries.notes: L 栏 'ygualar cortixera' 中 cortixera 拼写未能确解（或为 cortadera 之讹），主体义“裁齐”据 裁+ygualar 明确

entries.zh: 平肩；肩平齐整，与他人同等（如肩之平）
entries.en: level shoulders; even, equal like another (marginal 'L. xia alli como' unresolved)
entries.notes: 西注 igual como otro 与“平肩”的对应须经“肩平则齐”推断；M 栏另有旁注 L. xia alli como 未解

entries.zh: 钗中钗；钗环层叠相竞——似喻彼此相当、可分高下（西注残乱：“此辈可相胜，狡黠之戏”），确切所指存疑
entries.en: a hairpin within a hairpin; garbled Spanish marginal ('ensaliduria o bellaquería, these can outdo one another') — exact sense uncertain
entries.notes: L 栏 ensaliduria/bellaquería 拼写怪异难解，与“钗中钗”对应无法确证，仅按字面与西注大意猜测

entries.zh: 齐；齐整一律，同样齐等
entries.en: even, uniform; equal in the same manner

entries.zh: 侪；同侪，同一等次之辈（ut supra＝同上）
entries.en: peers, of the same class or rank; equals (as above)

entries.zh: 侪；同侪同等（字头上方另有圈注小字“苦”，与 M 栏首音节 gou 相应，所指存疑）
entries.en: peers, equals of the same order (small circled character “苦” above the head word, annotation unresolved)
entries.notes: 圈注小字“苦”与 M 栏 gou 音节相应但语义不明，主义仍按“侪＝同侪”

entries.zh: 匹配；相配成对，如婚配之匹配
entries.en: matched, paired like a married couple; well-matched

entries.zh: 同僚；同官共事、品位相同之人
entries.en: equals in dignity or rank; colleagues, fellow officials

entries.zh: 僚友；同僚友朋，品位相同之人
entries.en: colleagues and friends, equals in dignity
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节标 T99（污损难辨），按 H“僚友”与 L 栏释义，音写部分存疑

entries.zh: 对同；彼此对等相应，相同对应
entries.en: equality, correspondence; matching one another

entries.zh: 平；平齐均匀，同样同等
entries.en: level, even; equally, likewise (marginal 'mono igual' = even as a hand)

entries.zh: 彬彬；文质彬彬，彬雅有礼
entries.en: refined, polished; courteous (manuscript gloss 'igualmente', correspondence uncertain)
entries.notes: 字头“彬（彬）”本义文雅，与西注 Ygualmente（同样）不甚相合，按字头本义释义并存疑

entries.zh: 平均；均匀等同，持平不偏
entries.en: even, balanced; equal, evenly adjusted
entries.notes: M 栏照录原稿西班牙语 'ajustado ygual infuercay'，其中 infuercay 拼写未能确解；主义据“平均”与 ygual 明确

entries.zh: 平平；平平齐整，一样平坦（另读 peng peng，同义）
entries.en: flat, level; ordinary, even (two readings)

entries.zh: 同齐；同而齐，一样齐同
entries.en: alike, uniformly equal

entries.zh: 彬（乙读）；字头“彬”的第二种读法（“乙”或标异读），义同文雅之意
entries.en: 'pin' (second reading, marker 乙); manuscript gloss 'igualmente'
entries.notes: “乙”疑为异读标记之推断，本条实义以圈注重读 pin pin 与前条“彬彬”互参

entries.zh: 均（乙读）；字头“均”之异读（“乙”），重叠作“均均”，平齐均等之义
entries.en: 'kun' (second reading, marker 乙); equal, even; manuscript gloss 'igualmente'
entries.notes: “乙”疑为异读标记之推断；“均”字义与西注“同样均等”相合

entries.zh: 四脚蛇；蜥蜴——西注似言“同样为大的（蜥蜴）”（Ygualm de grande），条上有墨线划过
entries.en: four-footed snake, i.e. lizard (Spanish gloss partly struck through: 'igualmente de grande')
entries.notes: R 栏[残]、L 栏缩写 Ygualm 且条目被墨线划过，按 H“四脚蛇”＝蜥蜴字面释义，所指大小归属存疑
